drums.tags: Cinematic orchestral trailer music. The track features a heavy, rhythmic percussion ensemble consisting of taiko drums, orchestral bass drums, and metallic hits. A low-frequency synthesizer pulse syncs with the primary downbeats. Staccato string ostinatos in the cellos and violas provide a driving rhythmic layer. Brass sections, specifically trombones and tubas, perform short, accented low-register notes. High-pitched orchestral bells and metallic anvils punctuate the transitions. The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time, likely in the key of D minor. The arrangement follows a build-up structure, increasing in percussive density and volume through the addition of layered snare rolls and cymbal swells. Short, aggressive silence gaps are used for dramatic emphasis between phrases.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[Low synth pulse, distant taiko hits]
[Metallic anvil strikes]

[Build-up]
[Staccato string ostinato enters]
[Heavy orchestral bass drum hits on beats 1 and 3]
[Layered snare rolls with crescendo]

[Climax]
[Full percussion ensemble with taiko and metallic hits]
[Low brass accents on downbeats]
[High-pitched orchestral bell strikes]
[Cymbal crashes and swells]

[Outro]
[Final heavy bass drum hit with long reverb tail]
[Sub-bass fade out]

bass.tags: Dark ambient and industrial soundscape. The track features a low-frequency, distorted drone that oscillates with a slow, rhythmic pulse. A metallic, resonant texture sits in the mid-range, processed with heavy reverb and granular delay to create a cavernous space. High-frequency digital artifacts and static-like crackles appear sporadically. A deep, sub-bass throb provides a consistent rhythmic anchor at approximately 60 BPM. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the gradual evolution of timbres and the interplay between mechanical hums and airy, synthetic pads. There is no melodic progression or traditional harmonic structure.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[low-frequency distorted drone enters]
[metallic resonant texture with heavy reverb]

[Main Section]
[sub-bass throb at 60 BPM]
[granular delay on mid-range textures]
[sporadic digital artifacts and static crackles]

[Outro]
[high-frequency elements fade]
[low drone sustains and slowly decays]
